The spiritual travel itinerary for a spiritual journey in India:

Varanasi:

Varanasi is one of the oldest cities in India. It is located on the banks of the river Ganges. It is also known as the city of temples. Varanasi is one of the holiest cities in India. It is believed that Lord Shiva himself resides here. The city is also known for its temples and ghats. You can visit the famous temples like Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Sankat Mochan Temple and Vishalakshi Temple. You can also visit the famous ghats like Dashashwamedh Ghat and Assi Ghat.

Rishikesh:

Rishikesh is a spiritual center located in Uttarakhand. It is situated on the banks of the river Ganges. It is a place where you can find peace and tranquility. It is a place where you can meditate and find your inner self. Rishikesh is also known as the Yoga Capital of the World. You can visit the famous temples like Trimbakeshwar Temple, Ram Jhula and Lakshman Jhula. You can also visit the famous ashrams like Parmarth Niketan Ashram and Badrinath Ashram.

Amritsar:

Amritsar is a holy city located in Punjab. It is the holy city of the Sikhs. It is also known as the Golden Temple City. You can visit the famous Golden Temple here. It is one of the most beautiful temples in India. You can also visit the famous Jallianwala Bagh here. It is a place where thousands of people were killed by the British in 1919.

Haridwar:

Haridwar is a city located in Uttarakhand. It is also known as the City of Gods. It is a place where you can find peace and tranquility. You can visit the famous temples like Mansa Devi Temple, Chandi Devi Temple and Kali Devi Temple. You can also visit the famous ghats like Har Ki Pauri Ghat and Daksh Prajapati Ghat.
